info.description:
REST face of the homelab architecture manager. Three audiences, three doors:

* **People (the web app)**: `/api/*` except `/api/agent/*`. Reads need no credential. Changes to
  the architecture graph go through proposals; approving or rejecting one needs the approver
  header (production adds it at the Caddy site, see `docs/deployment.md`).
* **Agents**: `/api/agent/*` (and `/mcp`), bearer `AGENT_API_TOKEN`. Agents can read, and can create
  or withdraw `pending` proposals. They can never approve, reject or apply. Every agent answer uses
  the plain error shape `{"detail": "text", "issues"?: [...]}`.
* **Operators**: `/api/health`, `/api/deployment`.

No endpoint writes to the graph directly. A change is a *proposal* (a list of operations plus a
rationale) that a person approves; approving applies it.

Guide for agents: `docs/agent-guide.md`. Meaning of graph data (classes, relations, properties,
allowed values, authority): `GET /api/ontology`.
info.title: Homelab Architecture Manager

get.description:
The definition of the graph's vocabulary, and the closest thing to a data dictionary:
what each class (kind of thing) and relation (kind of connection) means, which properties
it has with their allowed values, and who may write each fact (`authority`: `provisioning`,
the YAML in the infra repo synced into the graph, or `graph`, changed only by proposals).
The agent interface serves a compact version at `GET /api/agent/ontology`.
